        dem[k] = Float64(inst.q[p])
        floor_v[k] = Float64(jp.point.z)

        sweep[k] = mod(ang, 2.0 * pi) / (2.0 * pi)
    end

        mx = maximum(arr)

    norm_vec!(slack)
    norm_vec!(dist)
    norm_vec!(cross)

    w_cross = rand(params.rng) * 1.5

        pz[k] = pz_k

        dx[k] = dx_k
        dy[k] = dy_k
        dz[k] = dz_k

        ep[k] = ep_k
        ld[k] = ld_k
        slack[k] = ld_k - ep_k

        if px_k < min_x; min_x = px_k; end
        if px_k > max_x; max_x = px_k; end
        if py_k < min_y; min_y = py_k; end
        if py_k > max_y; max_y = py_k; end
        if ep_k < min_t; min_t = ep_k; end
        if ld_k > max_t; max_t = ld_k; end
    end

    max_dist = max(sqrt((max_x - min_x)^2 + (max_y - min_y)^2), 1.0)
    max_time = max(max_t - min_t, 1.0)

    w_p = 0.5 + 1.5 * rand(params.rng)
    w_d = 0.2 + 1.0 * rand(params.rng)
    w_t = 0.5 + 2.0 * rand(params.rng)
    w_z = 1.0 + 3.0 * rand(params.rng)
    w_slack = 0.1 + 0.6 * rand(params.rng)
    noise_w = 0.05 + 0.25 * rand(params.rng)

    visited = fill(false, n)
    result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)

    curr = 1
    if rand(params.rng) < 0.6
        best_score = Inf
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            sc = ep[k] / max_time + noise_w * rand(params.rng)
            if sc < best_score
                best_score = sc
                curr = k
            end
        end
    else
        curr = rand(params.rng, 1:n)
    end

    visited[curr] = true
    result[1] = Int64(inst.V_p[curr])

    @inbounds for step in 2:n
        curr_px = px[curr]
        curr_py = py[curr]
        curr_pz = pz[curr]
        curr_dx = dx[curr]
        curr_dy = dy[curr]
        curr_dz = dz[curr]
        curr_ep = ep[curr]

        best_cost = Inf
        best_k = -1

        for k in 1:n
            if visited[k]
                continue
            end

            dpx = px[k] - curr_px
            dpy = py[k] - curr_py
            dist_p = sqrt(dpx * dpx + dpy * dpy) / max_dist

            ddx = dx[k] - curr_dx
            ddy = dy[k] - curr_dy
            dist_d = sqrt(ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy) / max_dist

            dist_z = abs(pz[k] - curr_pz) + abs(dz[k] - curr_dz)

            dt = ep[k] - curr_ep
            dist_t = dt >= 0.0 ? (dt / max_time) : (-2.0 * dt / max_time)

            cost = w_p * dist_p +
                   w_d * dist_d +
                   w_z * dist_z +
                   w_t * dist_t +
                   w_slack * (slack[k] / max_time) +

                best_k = k
            end
        end

        curr = best_k
        visited[curr] = true
        result[step] = Int64(inst.V_p[curr])
    end

    return result
end

    end

    px = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    py = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    pz = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
    dx = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    dy = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    dz = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
    ep = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    ld = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    q  = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    dist_pd = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

    min_x = Inf
    max_x = -Inf
    min_y = Inf
    max_y = -Inf
    min_e = Inf
    max_l = -Inf
    max_q = 1.0

    @inbounds for k in 1:n
        p = inst.V_p[k]
        d = inst.V_d[k]

        jp = inst.jobs[p]
        jd = inst.jobs[d]

        px[k] = Float64(jp.point.x)
        py[k] = Float64(jp.point.y)
        pz[k] = Int64(jp.point.z)

        dx[k] = Float64(jd.point.x)
        dy[k] = Float64(jd.point.y)
        dz[k] = Int64(jd.point.z)

        ep[k] = Float64(inst.e[p])
        ld[k] = Float64(inst.l[d])
        q[k]  = Float64(inst.q[p])

        dist_pd[k] = sqrt((px[k] - dx[k])^2 + (py[k] - dy[k])^2)

        min_x = min(min_x, px[k], dx[k])
        max_x = max(max_x, px[k], dx[k])
        min_y = min(min_y, py[k], dy[k])
        max_y = max(max_y, py[k], dy[k])

        min_e = min(min_e, ep[k])
        max_l = max(max_l, ld[k])
        max_q = max(max_q, q[k])
    end

    scale_dist = max(1.0, sqrt((max_x - min_x)^2 + (max_y - min_y)^2))
    scale_time = max(1.0, max_l - min_e)

    mode = rand(params.rng)
    order_indices = Vector{Int64}()
    sizehint!(order_indices, n)

    if mode < 0.35
        # Strategy 1: Urgency & Bottleneck Difficulty Priority Sorting
        w_slack = 1.0 + rand(params.rng) * 2.0
        w_ep    = 0.6 + rand(params.rng) * 1.4
        w_len   = 0.3 + rand(params.rng) * 0.9
        w_fl    = 0.5 + rand(params.rng) * 1.5
        w_q     = 0.2 + rand(params.rng) * 0.6

        scores = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            slack_norm = (ld[k] - ep[k]) / scale_time
            ep_norm    = (ep[k] - min_e) / scale_time
            len_norm   = dist_pd[k] / scale_dist
            fl_pen     = (pz[k] != dz[k]) ? 1.0 : 0.0
            q_norm     = q[k] / max_q

            scores[k] = - w_slack * slack_norm +
                          w_ep * ep_norm +
                          w_len * len_norm +
                          w_fl * fl_pen -
                          w_q * q_norm +
                          0.15 * rand(params.rng)
        end
        order_indices = sortperm(scores)

    elseif mode < 0.70
        # Strategy 2: Floor-Clustered Spatio-Temporal Sweep
        floors = Int64[]
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            fl = pz[k]
            if !(fl in floors)
                push!(floors, fl)
            end
        end
        num_floors = length(floors)

        floor_scores = Vector{Float64}(undef, num_floors)
        @inbounds for f_idx in 1:num_floors
            fl = floors[f_idx]
            min_f_ep = Inf
            for k in 1:n
                if pz[k] == fl && ep[k] < min_f_ep
                    min_f_ep = ep[k]
                end
            end
            floor_scores[f_idx] = min_f_ep + rand(params.rng) * scale_time * 0.5
        end

        floor_perm = sortperm(floor_scores)

        @inbounds for f_rank in 1:num_floors
            fl = floors[floor_perm[f_rank]]
            reqs_on_floor = Int64[]
            cx = 0.0
            cy = 0.0

            for k in 1:n
                if pz[k] == fl
                    push!(reqs_on_floor, k)
                    cx += px[k]
                    cy += py[k]
                end
            end

            nf = length(reqs_on_floor)
            if nf > 0
                cx /= nf
                cy /= nf

                req_scores = Vector{Float64}(undef, nf)
                w_ang = 0.5 + rand(params.rng)
                w_tm  = 0.5 + rand(params.rng)

                for i in 1:nf
                    k = reqs_on_floor[i]
                    ang = atan(py[k] - cy, px[k] - cx)
                    req_scores[i] = w_ang * ang + w_tm * (ep[k] / scale_time) + 0.2 * rand(params.rng)
                end

                p = sortperm(req_scores)
                for i in 1:nf
                    push!(order_indices, reqs_on_floor[p[i]])
                end
            end
        end

        if length(order_indices) < n
            visited = fill(false, n)
            for idx in order_indices
                visited[idx] = true
            end
            for k in 1:n
                if !visited[k]
                    push!(order_indices, k)
                end
            end
        end

    else
        # Strategy 3: Multi-Candidate Regret Spatio-Temporal Chain
        visited = fill(false, n)
        order_indices = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)

        ep_order = sortperm(ep)
        top_start = min(3, n)
        start_k = ep_order[rand(params.rng, 1:top_start)]

        order_indices[1] = start_k
        visited[start_k] = true

        w_space = 0.4 + rand(params.rng) * 0.8
        w_time  = 0.4 + rand(params.rng) * 0.8
        w_floor = 0.8 + rand(params.rng) * 1.2
        w_slack = 0.2 + rand(params.rng) * 0.6

        @inbounds for step in 2:n
            prev = order_indices[step - 1]

            best1_k = -1
            best1_c = Inf
            best2_k = -1
            best2_c = Inf

            for k in 1:n
                if !visited[k]
                    d1 = sqrt((px[k] - px[prev])^2 + (py[k] - py[prev])^2)
                    d2 = sqrt((px[k] - dx[prev])^2 + (py[k] - dy[prev])^2)
                    d_sp = min(d1, d2) / scale_dist

                    f_pen = (pz[k] != pz[prev] && pz[k] != dz[prev]) ? 1.0 : 0.0
                    t_gap = max(0.0, ep[k] - ep[prev]) / scale_time
                    slack = (ld[k] - ep[k]) / scale_time

                    c = w_space * d_sp +
                        w_floor * f_pen +
                        w_time * t_gap +
                        w_slack * slack +
                        0.05 * rand(params.rng)

                    if c < best1_c
                        best2_c = best1_c
                        best2_k = best1_k
                        best1_c = c
                        best1_k = k
                    elseif c < best2_c
                        best2_c = c
                        best2_k = k
                    end
                end
            end

            chosen = (best2_k != -1 && rand(params.rng) < 0.2) ? best2_k : best1_k
            order_indices[step] = chosen
            visited[chosen] = true
        end
    end

        w_floor    = 1.2 + rand(params.rng) * 2.0

        w_vector   = 0.3 + rand(params.rng) * 0.7

            v1_y = dy[prev] - py[prev]

            c1, c2, c3 = -1, -1, -1
            v1, v2, v3 = Inf, Inf, Inf

                    d_deadhead = sqrt((px[k] - dx[prev])^2 + (py[k] - dy[prev])^2) / scale_dist
                    f_pen = (pz[k] != dz[prev]) ? 1.0 : 0.0
                    t_gap = max(0.0, ep[k] - ep[prev]) / scale_time
                    t_diff = abs(ep[k] - ep[prev]) / scale_time
                    slack = (ld[k] - ep[k]) / scale_time

                    v2_x = dx[k] - px[k]
                    v2_y = dy[k] - py[k]
                    len2 = max(1e-3, sqrt(v2_x^2 + v2_y^2))
                    dot_prod = (v1_x * v2_x + v1_y * v2_y) / (len1 * len2)
                    v_pen = 1.0 - dot_prod

                           w_floor * f_pen +
                           w_timegap * (0.7 * t_gap + 0.3 * t_diff) +
                           w_urgency * slack +
                           w_vector * v_pen +
                           0.03 * rand(params.rng)

                    if cost < v1

                        c2, v2 = c1, v1
                        c1, v1 = k, cost
                    elseif cost < v2
                        c3, v3 = c2, v2
                        c2, v2 = k, cost
                    elseif cost < v3
                        c3, v3 = k, cost
                    end
                end
            end

            pool_size = (c1 != -1) + (c2 != -1) + (c3 != -1)
            chosen = c1
            if pool_size >= 2 && rand(params.rng) < 0.35
                chosen = c2
            elseif pool_size >= 3 && rand(params.rng) < 0.15
                chosen = c3
            end

            order[step] = chosen
            visited[chosen] = true
        end

    elseif r_archetype < 0.70
        # Archetype 2: Floor Partition & Space-Time Priority
        scores = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
        w_time = 5.0 + rand(params.rng) * 5.0
        w_space = 1.0 + rand(params.rng) * 2.0
        w_flr = 20.0 + rand(params.rng) * 10.0

        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            t_norm = (ep[k] - min_e) / scale_time
            s_norm = (px[k] - min_x) / scale_dist
            scores[k] = pz[k] * w_flr + t_norm * w_time + s_norm * w_space + 0.2 * rand(params.rng)
        end
        order = sortperm(scores)

    elseif r_archetype < 0.85
        # Archetype 3: Difficulty & Bottleneck Priority (Hardest Requests First)
        scores = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
        w_tw = 2.0 + rand(params.rng) * 2.0
        w_len = 1.5 + rand(params.rng) * 1.5
        w_dem = 0.5 + rand(params.rng) * 0.5

        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            trip_len = sqrt((dx[k] - px[k])^2 + (dy[k] - py[k])^2) / scale_dist
            tw_width = (ld[k] - ep[k]) / scale_time
            dem_ratio = q[k] / max_q
            time_rank = (ep[k] - min_e) / scale_time

            scores[k] = - w_tw * tw_width + w_len * trip_len + w_dem * dem_ratio - 0.8 * time_rank + 0.2 * rand(params.rng)
        end
        order = sortperm(scores, rev=true)

    else
        # Archetype 4: Polar Angle Space-Time Sweep
        scores = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
        cx_mid = (min_x + max_x) / 2.0
        cy_mid = (min_y + max_y) / 2.0
        w_ang = 1.0 + rand(params.rng) * 1.0
        w_tim = 3.0 + rand(params.rng) * 3.0

        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            cx = (px[k] + dx[k]) / 2.0
            cy = (py[k] + dy[k]) / 2.0
            angle = atan(cy - cy_mid, cx - cx_mid)
            t_norm = (ep[k] - min_e) / scale_time

            scores[k] = w_tim * t_norm + w_ang * (angle / 3.14159) + 1.5 * pz[k] + 0.1 * rand(params.rng)
        end
        order = sortperm(scores)
    end

    result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
    @inbounds for k in 1:n
        result[k] = Int64(inst.V_p[order[k]])
    end

    return result
end

            scores[k] = pz * 1000.0 + ep + 0.01 * ld + rand(params.rng) * jitter_scale * (ep + 1.0)
        end

    elseif mode == 3
        # Mode 3: Trip hardness (longer distance and higher demand first)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            p = inst.V_p[k]
            d = inst.V_d[k]
            jp = inst.jobs[p]
            jd = inst.jobs[d]

            dx = Float64(jp.point.x - jd.point.x)
            dy = Float64(jp.point.y - jd.point.y)
            dz = Float64(jp.point.z - jd.point.z)
            dist = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + abs(dz) * 10.0
            dem = Float64(inst.q[p])
            ep = Float64(inst.e[p])

            scores[k] = -(dist + 0.5 * dem) + 0.1 * ep + rand(params.rng) * jitter_scale * (dist + 1.0)
        end

    else
        # Mode 4: Spatial sweep angle around centroid with floor & time priority
        cx = 0.0
        cy = 0.0
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            p = inst.V_p[k]
            cx += Float64(inst.jobs[p].point.x)
            cy += Float64(inst.jobs[p].point.y)
        end
        cx /= n
        cy /= n

        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            p = inst.V_p[k]
            jp = inst.jobs[p]
            px = Float64(jp.point.x) - cx
            py = Float64(jp.point.y) - cy
            angle = atan(py, px)
            ep = Float64(inst.e[p])
            pz = Float64(jp.point.z)

            scores[k] = angle * 10.0 + pz * 100.0 + 0.1 * ep + rand(params.rng) * jitter_scale
        end
    end

    perm = sortperm(scores)
    result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
    @inbounds for k in 1:n
        result[k] = Int64(inst.V_p[perm[k]])
    end

    return result
end

        end

            noise = rand(params.rng) * 0.05

    result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)

        # Family 2: Pair-Tightness Ordering (Slack & Cross-Floor Bottlenecks First)

        keys_slack = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

            cross_floor = (jp.point.z != jd.point.z) ? 1.0 : 0.0

            slack = max(0.01, ld - ep)
            # Priority score: cross-floor bottlenecks first, then early start & tight pair slack
            keys_slack[k] = 2.0 * ep + slack - 0.5 * dist_pd + cross_floor * 100.0 + rand(params.rng) * 0.2
        end
        order_indices = sortperm(keys_slack)

    else
        # Family 3: Strict Lexicographic Multi-Key Priority
        # Primary key: Earliest pickup time; Secondary key: Delivery deadline; Tertiary key: Spatial X-coord.
        keys_lex = Vector{Tuple{Float64, Float64, Float64}}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            p = inst.V_p[k]
            d = inst.V_d[k]
            jp = inst.jobs[p]

            ld = Float64(inst.l[d])
            px = Float64(jp.point.x)
            noise = rand(params.rng) * 0.01

            keys_lex[k] = (ep + noise, ld, px)
        end
        order_indices = sortperm(keys_lex)
    end

    result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
    @inbounds for i in 1:n
        result[i] = Int64(inst.V_p[order_indices[i]])
    end

    return result

    n = inst.n
    if n <= 1
        return Vector{Int64}(inst.V_p)
    end

    ep = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    ld = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    xp = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    yp = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    zp = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
    slack = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

    min_e = Inf
    max_e = -Inf

    @inbounds for k in 1:n
        p = inst.V_p[k]
        d = inst.V_d[k]

        jp = inst.jobs[p]
        jd = inst.jobs[d]

        ep[k] = Float64(inst.e[p])
        ld[k] = Float64(inst.l[d])
        xp[k] = Float64(jp.point.x)
        yp[k] = Float64(jp.point.y)
        zp[k] = Int64(jp.point.z)
        slack[k] = ld[k] - ep[k]

        min_e = min(min_e, ep[k])
        max_e = max(max_e, ep[k])
    end

    time_span = max(1.0, max_e - min_e)

    unique_floors = Int64[]
    @inbounds for k in 1:n
        f = zp[k]
        found = false
        for u in unique_floors
            if u == f
                found = true
                break
            end
        end
        if !found
            push!(unique_floors, f)
        end
    end

    num_floors = length(unique_floors)
    floor_min_time = fill(Inf, num_floors)

    @inbounds for k in 1:n
        f = zp[k]
        for fi in 1:num_floors
            if unique_floors[fi] == f
                if ep[k] < floor_min_time[fi]
                    floor_min_time[fi] = ep[k]
                end
                break
            end
        end
    end

    floor_keys = Vector{Float64}(undef, num_floors)
    @inbounds for fi in 1:num_floors
        floor_keys[fi] = floor_min_time[fi] + rand(params.rng) * 0.1 * time_span
    end

    floor_perm = sortperm(floor_keys)

    ordered_requests = Int64[]
    sizehint!(ordered_requests, n)

    use_spatial_sweep = rand(params.rng) < 0.5

    @inbounds for f_idx in floor_perm
        target_floor = unique_floors[f_idx]

        floor_reqs = Int64[]
        for k in 1:n
            if zp[k] == target_floor
                push!(floor_reqs, k)
            end
        end

        m = length(floor_reqs)
        if m == 0
            continue
        end

        if use_spatial_sweep && m > 2
            cx = 0.0
            cy = 0.0
            for r in floor_reqs
                cx += xp[r]
                cy += yp[r]
            end
            cx /= m
            cy /= m

            angles = Vector{Float64}(undef, m)
            for i in 1:m
                r = floor_reqs[i]
                ang = atan(yp[r] - cy, xp[r] - cx)
                time_ratio = (ep[r] - min_e) / time_span
                angles[i] = ang + 2.0 * pi * time_ratio + rand(params.rng) * 0.1
            end
            p_sort = sortperm(angles)
            for i in p_sort
                push!(ordered_requests, floor_reqs[i])
            end
        else
            sort_keys = Vector{Tuple{Float64, Float64, Float64}}(undef, m)
            for i in 1:m
                r = floor_reqs[i]
                pert_ep = ep[r] + rand(params.rng) * 0.05 * time_span
                sort_keys[i] = (pert_ep, ld[r], slack[r])
            end
            p_sort = sortperm(sort_keys)
            for i in p_sort
                push!(ordered_requests, floor_reqs[i])
            end
        end
    end

    result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
    @inbounds for k in 1:n
        result[k] = Int64(inst.V_p[ordered_requests[k]])
    end

    return result
end

function llm_candidate_score(inst::InstanceData, params::ParameterData)::Vector{Int64}
    n = inst.n
    if n <= 1
        return Vector{Int64}(inst.V_p)
    end

    mode_roll = rand(params.rng)

    if mode_roll < 0.45
        # Mode 1: Island-Clustered Lexicographic Sorting
        floors = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
        ep_vals = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
        span_vals = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            p = inst.V_p[k]
            d = inst.V_d[k]
            jp = inst.jobs[p]
            floors[k] = Int64(jp.point.z)
            ep_vals[k] = Float64(inst.e[p])
            span_vals[k] = Float64(inst.l[d]) - Float64(inst.e[p])
        end

        floor_min_e = Dict{Int64, Float64}()
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            fz = floors[k]
            if !haskey(floor_min_e, fz) || ep_vals[k] < floor_min_e[fz]
                floor_min_e[fz] = ep_vals[k]
            end
        end

        keys = Vector{Tuple{Float64, Int64, Float64, Float64}}(undef, n)
        noise_scale = 5.0
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            fz = floors[k]
            f_start = floor_min_e[fz]
            perturbed_ep = ep_vals[k] + rand(params.rng) * noise_scale
            keys[k] = (f_start, fz, perturbed_ep, span_vals[k])
        end

        perm = sortperm(keys)
        result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            result[k] = Int64(inst.V_p[perm[k]])
        end
        return result

    elseif mode_roll < 0.75
        # Mode 2: Tightness and Urgency Bottleneck First
        keys_tightness = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            p = inst.V_p[k]
            d = inst.V_d[k]
            e_p = Float64(inst.e[p])
            l_p = Float64(inst.l[p])
            l_d = Float64(inst.l[d])
            e_d = Float64(inst.e[d])

            pair_slack = l_d - e_p
            p_window = l_p - e_p
            d_window = l_d - e_d

            noise = (rand(params.rng) - 0.5) * 10.0
            keys_tightness[k] = pair_slack + 0.5 * p_window + 0.3 * d_window + 0.1 * e_p + noise
        end

        perm = sortperm(keys_tightness)
        result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            result[k] = Int64(inst.V_p[perm[k]])
        end
        return result

    else
        # Mode 3: Delivery-to-Pickup Spatial & Temporal Chaining
        visited = fill(false, n)
        order = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)

        best_e = Inf
        start_k = 1
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            p = inst.V_p[k]
            val = Float64(inst.e[p]) + rand(params.rng) * 2.0
            if val < best_e
                best_e = val
                start_k = k
            end
        end

        order[1] = start_k
        visited[start_k] = true

        @inbounds for step in 2:n
            prev_k = order[step - 1]
            prev_d = inst.V_d[prev_k]
            jd_prev = inst.jobs[prev_d]
            ld_prev = Float64(inst.l[prev_d])

            best_next = -1
            best_cost = Inf

            for k in 1:n
                if !visited[k]
                    pk = inst.V_p[k]
                    jp_k = inst.jobs[pk]
                    ep_k = Float64(inst.e[pk])

                    dx = Float64(jp_k.point.x - jd_prev.point.x)
                    dy = Float64(jp_k.point.y - jd_prev.point.y)
                    spatial_dist = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)

                    floor_diff = (jp_k.point.z == jd_prev.point.z) ? 0.0 : 50.0
                    time_wait = max(0.0, ep_k - ld_prev)

                    cost = spatial_dist + floor_diff + 0.2 * time_wait + 0.05 * ep_k + rand(params.rng) * 3.0

                    if cost < best_cost
                        best_cost = cost
                        best_next = k
                    end
                end
            end

            order[step] = best_next
            visited[best_next] = true
        end

        result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            result[k] = Int64(inst.V_p[order[k]])
        end
        return result
    end
